nodes.label: A domain feature is a pack of the registry; the engine ships no pack with tools of its own
nodes.summary: A domain feature is a pack of the registry, its tools in its own `code/` and its tests beside it; the engine ships no pack that provides a command, a build stage or a hook, and `ddd`, the first, moves to Cynergis/oto-registry as the `ddd` pack.
